About the Species

Blue whales are the largest animals ever to live on our planet. They feed almost exclusively on krill, straining huge volumes of ocean water through their baleen plates (which hang from the roof of the mouth and work like a sieve). Some of the biggest individuals may eat up to 6 tons of krill a day.

Blue whales are found in all oceans except the Arctic Ocean. There are five currently recognized subspecies of blue whales.

The number of blue whales today is only a small fraction of what it was before modern commercial whaling significantly reduced their numbers during the early 1900s, but populations are increasing globally. The primary threats blue whales currently face are vessel strikes and entanglements in fishing gear.

NOAA Fisheries and its partners are dedicated to conserving and rebuilding blue whale populations worldwide. We use a variety of innovative techniques to study, protect, and rescue these endangered animals. We engage our partners as we develop regulations and management plans that foster healthy fisheries and reduce the risk of entanglements, create whale-safe shipping practices, and reduce ocean noise.

Population Status
Blue whales were significantly depleted by commercial whaling activities worldwide. Today, blue whales are listed as endangered under the Endangered Species Act and protected under the Marine Mammal Protection Act. The latest stock assessment reports of blue whales include data for various stocks, including areas of the North Pacific and western North Atlantic Oceans.

Appearance
Blue whales have a long body and generally slender shape. Their mottled blue-gray color appears light blue under water—hence their name, the blue whale. The mottling pattern is variable and can be used to identify individuals.

Antarctic blue whales are generally larger than other blue whale subspecies. For example, in the North Atlantic and North Pacific, blue whales can grow up to about 90 feet and are over 100,000 pounds, but in the Antarctic, they can reach up to about 110 feet and weigh more than 330,000 pounds. Like many other baleen whales, female blue whales are generally larger than males.

Behavior and Diet
Blue whales sometimes swim in small groups but are more often found alone or in pairs. They generally spend summers feeding in polar waters and undertake lengthy migrations towards the equatorial waters as winter arrives.

Blue whales typically swim at about 5 miles an hour while they are feeding and traveling, but can accelerate to more than 20 miles an hour for short bursts. They are among the loudest animals on the planet, emitting a series of pulses, groans, and moans, and it is thought that in the right oceanographic conditions, sounds emitted by blue whales can be heard by other whales up to 1,000 miles away. Scientists think they use these vocalizations to communicate and—along with their excellent hearing—perhaps to sonar-navigate the dark ocean depths.

The primary diet of blue whales is krill—tiny shrimp-like animals, but fish and copepods (tiny crustaceans) may occasionally be part of the blue whale’s diet. When blue whales hunt for food, they filter feed by swimming toward large schools of krill with their mouth open and closing their mouths around the krill while inflating their throat pleats. Once closed, blue whales then push the trapped water out of their mouth with their tongue and use their baleen plates to keep the krill trapped inside.

Where They Live
Blue whales are found in all oceans except the Arctic. They generally migrate seasonally between summer feeding grounds and winter breeding grounds, but some evidence suggests that individuals in certain areas might not migrate at all. Information about distribution and movement varies with location, and migratory routes are not well known. In general, distribution is driven largely by food availability—they occur in waters where krill are concentrated.

In the North Atlantic Ocean, their range extends from the subtropics to the Greenland Sea. Blue whales have been sighted in the waters off eastern Canada and in the shelf waters of the eastern United States.

Along the West Coast of the United States, eastern North Pacific blue whales are believed to spend winters off of Mexico and Central America. They likely feed during summer off the U.S. West Coast and, to a lesser extent, in the Gulf of Alaska and central North Pacific waters.

Blue whales with young calves are regularly observed in the Gulf of California (Sea of Cortez) from December through March. It is believed that this area is an important calving and nursing area for the species.

In the northern Indian Ocean, there is a "resident" population. Blue whale sightings, strandings, and acoustic detections have been reported from the Gulf of Aden, Arabian Sea, and across the Bay of Bengal. The migratory movements of these whales are largely unknown but may be driven by oceanographic changes associated with monsoons.

In the Southern Hemisphere, Antarctic blue whales occur mainly in relatively high latitude waters south of the "Antarctic Convergence" and close to the ice edge in summer. They generally migrate to middle and low latitudes in winter, although not all whales migrate each year. Pygmy blue whales (Balaenoptera musculus brevicauda)—a subspecies—are typically distributed north of the Antarctic Convergence and are most abundant in waters off Australia, Madagascar, and New Zealand. An unnamed subspecies of blue whale is found in the southeastern Pacific Ocean, particularly in the Chiloense Ecoregion, and migrates to lower latitude areas, including the Galapagos Islands and the eastern tropical Pacific.

Lifespan & Reproduction
Blue whales’ average lifespan is estimated at around 80 to 90 years. Scientists can estimate the age of whales by counting the layers of wax-like earplugs collected from deceased animals.

Scientists know little about the life history of the blue whale. The best available science suggests the gestation period is approximately 10 to 12 months. Weaning probably occurs at around 6 to 7 months on, or en route to, summer feeding areas. The age of sexual maturity is thought to be 5 to 15 years. Most reproductive activity, including births and mating, takes place during the winter. The average calving interval is probably 2 to 3 years.

Threats
Vessel Strikes
Vessel strikes can injure or kill blue whales. Vessel strikes have killed blue whales throughout their range, but the risk is much higher in some coastal areas with heavy vessel traffic, like ports and in shipping lanes, and from larger vessels and vessels traveling at high speeds.

Entanglement in Fishing Gear
Blue whales can become entangled in fishing gear, either swimming off with the gear attached or becoming anchored. Blue whales can become entangled in many different gear types, including traps, pots, and nets. Once entangled, whales may drag the attached gear for long distances, ultimately resulting in fatigue, compromised feeding ability, or severe injury, which may lead to reduced reproductive success and death.

Additional Threats
Additional possible threats to blue whales that are less understood include ocean noise, habitat degradation, pollution, vessel disturbance, and climate change.

You essentially start over, but this new beginning is murky and filled with doubt and shadows.\nBeing lost doesn't always involve being in an unfamiliar place with no understanding of how to return to what is recognizable. prompt: Write an article (<300 words) on the topic of repairing sheetrock. Discuss the general method of repairing small and larger holes in sheetrock. Include general information on the cost of sheetrock, drywall joint compound, and drywall tape.
messages:
[{'content': 'Write an article (<300 words) on the topic of repairing sheetrock. Discuss the general method of repairing small and larger holes in sheetrock. Include general information on the cost of sheetrock, drywall joint compound, and drywall tape.', 'role': 'user'}
 {'content': 'Small holes or cracks in sheetrock are easy to repair. Using a putty knife, or just your finger, spread some spackle into the hole or along the crack. Allow that to dry for several hours, then
lightly sand the area. You may need to touch up the paint. One jar of spackle costs a few dollars and can last up to a year or more. Keep the cover on tightly to prevent it from drying out.

If you have a larger hole to cover, then it’s best to make a nice clean square-shaped cut using a hand saw. Next, cut out a piece of sheet rock the exact size of the hole. Gently place the sheetrock into the hole and tape and bed the area just as you normally would when hanging drywall. This involves applying tape and then texturing over it and sanding.

Sheetrock is purchased in 4’ X 8’ pieces and is available in various thicknesses. Try to match what you currently have in your walls when making repairs. A 4’ X 8’ sheet costs anywhere from $12 to $20 per piece. Drywall joint compound (or mud) is about $20 for a 5-pound bucket. Drywall tape comes in at around $5 for a 250-foot roll.

Though it may seem like a lot of trouble, once you buy these items, you’ll have them out in the garage or shed for any future sheetrocking repairs. These products can last for years when stored properly.', 'role': 'assistant'}]

Are you done with looking like you've got a 5 o'clock shadow on your upper lip? Or maybe you're rocking some dark spots that seem to be taking over your face like it's their real estate? Learn about some amazing treatment options we've dished out for you below:

1. Buff Away Dark Spots: Regularly exfoliating your skin can reduce hyperpigmentation by removing dead skin cells and promoting cell turnover. Try alpha hydroxy acid or beta hydroxy acid exfoliants for the best results.

2. Zap Those Spots: In-office procedures like laser therapy and chemical peels can target hyperpigmentation by breaking up melanin clusters in the skin. These procedures require little downtime and can provide dramatic results. Your dermatologist can choose the appropriate chemical peel for you. Laser treatments, like Fraxel or IPL, can effectively lighten or remove hyperpigmentation. Always talk to a board-certified dermatologist before any laser treatment.

3. Shield Your Skin: Sun exposure is the devil. Use something like sunscreen with an SPF of 40 or higher. Wear protective clothing like hats and long sleeves when spending time outdoors. Shielding your skin from the sun can prevent further darkening. 

4. Skin-Brightening Ingredients: The market is bursting with topical treatments like niacinamide and hydroquinone. It can fade hyperpigmentation over time. Find products with these ingredients and use them consistently.

5. Address Underlying Conditions: Hyperpigmentation may require a professional diagnosis and treatment plan. Visiting your dermatologist is the best way to pinpoint the cause of your hyperpigmentation and decide on a personalized treatment regimen.  {'content': "The BLT is a classic sandwich for a reason. It's got everything from salty bacon to crisp lettuce and tops it off with a juicy tomato. But let me tell you, we can make it even better.

First things first, let's talk about bread. Now you don't want something too crunchy like a French baguette or ciabatta roll. So we aren't going down that route, but you also don't want a regular old loaf of white bread either. The best bread is a loaf with some density and bite to it, like a country white loaf. You could even use brioche if you want something richer. 

Next up are the toppings. Cooking your bacon of choice is the easy part. An air fryer or oven makes it simple to clean too. But where this recipe shines are the extra ingredients. I always add sliced red onion to my BLT. It adds a spicy and sharp bite that cuts through the fattiness of the bacon grease. I also add in gorgonzola cheese crumbles, but any tangy blue cheese will do. The important part is how we are adding layer upon layer of flavor. Every piece is important till it rises into a crescendo.

The most important part, though, is the tomato. Slice them super thin, I mean nearly see-through, then season them with salt and pepper and set aside. The salt draws out some of the water and really makes them taste like they are bursting with tomatoey goodness. You will not believe this flavor bomb hack. It's like a zing shooting through your body, and your jaw will drop.

Now to assemble the sandwich; what I do is get two slices of bread out, then I use a thin layer of mustard on one piece. Anything works though I prefer a dijon. Then a thin layer of mayo on the other half. Next, I add the cheese on both sides and put them into a toaster oven until the bread is brown and the cheese is melty. Finally, you take it out, put on the cooked bacon, tomato, lettuce, and onion, and there you have it! Cut it on a diagonal and chow down. I promise you will not be disappointed.

And feel free to jazz it up any way you like. Some hot peppers would work great too! Yum!

 {'content': 'I can certainly help you to understand the intricacies of the Fourth Amendment and how police observe the rights of citizens. Here are some ways in which the Fourth Amendment governs how police conduct investigations while protecting individual rights:

1. The Fourth Amendment to the United States Constitution protects all citizens from unreasonable searches and seizures of their persons and their property, unless by a search and seizure warrant, and only if the warrant details the probable cause of the search or seizure, the person or things to be seized, and the locations where these things will be found.
2. Probable cause is the legal standard that police officers must adhere to when seizing (arresting) a person or searching a person, place, or thing. Probable cause is defined as that which would cause a reasonable person to believe that a crime has been, is being, or will be committed and that the person being seized is the one who committed the crime, or that the place or thing being searched contain fruits of the crime (i.e. evidence).
3. When an officer has probable cause to seize a person, place, or thing or search said person, place, or thing, they will draft a search warrant that will be reviewed by a judge and filed with the court of jurisdiction where the crime took place.
4. Sometimes exceptions to the search warrant rule will still warrant a seizure or search if the exception has been previously recognized by the courts through a previous ruling, and when requiring a search or seizure warrant would have put an excessive burden on the police to prevent the death or injury of another person, property damage, or the destruction of evidence. Examples of this include the exigent circumstance exception (police not searching or seizing immediately would result in someone getting killed or hurt, such as arresting a person without a warrant as they are in the process of attempting to kill someone), or plain view exception (a police officer sees a person attempting to flush drugs down a toilet in their residence, so a search warrant may not be needed to enter the home and retrieve the drugs before they are destroyed.)

Nearly frantic Jimmy started calling out for his mom before realizing she wasn't home.

That's when he saw it on the table. His mom had already set out a tray of cookies with a note telling him to enjoy himself and to be a good boy. An empty glass stood next to the plate piled high with cookies and Jimmy quickly filled it with milk from the fridge. This was the best part. Sitting down, his feet barely touching the floor, Jimmy dunked an Oreo into the milk. He let it soak up for a few seconds before consuming it in one all-too-big bite.

Every cookie was a different adventure and a different creation. Sometimes he would eat the cream first, and sometimes he wouldn't even dunk them at all.  Then, staring at his last two cookies, a new idea came to him.  Picking both cookies up, he put them directly into the milk and let them sink to the bottom. 

After a minute passed. Jimmy grabbed a spoon and plunged it into the milk. He tried to fish out his cookies only to find nothing but crumbles. Disappointed at first he poked around more and stirred up the dregs. The milk turned from a pristine white to a muddier brown as chocolate bits danced, swirled, and mixed in. Marveling at his new concoction, Jimmy took the spoon out and gave it a sip. Then another sip, and then he drank the whole thing in one go. This was better than any cookie he had eaten. An Oreo milkshake! What a discovery. Jimmy set the glass down satisfied and with dreams in his head of making another one tomorrow after school.", 'role': 'assistant'}]

It soaked up the sun’s harsh rays during the day and weathered the nighttime frost and waited patiently for the day when the rain would finally bless the brittle valley. 

When it did, the droplets were such a relief to the parched little plant, but it knew that it needed to make this water last. And so, for the rest of the storm, it focused all of its energy on pulling the water that fell upon its stem inward. 

Weeks passed and the land dried back up, but the plant remained cool and content with its core full of water. The ground below could feel the moisture emanating from the plant’s roots and tugged at them, pulling them deeper and deeper, and the plant grew strong.

For many years this system worked without fail, but life was evolving rapidly and new creatures were moving to the valley every day. These creatures were not able to store their water in the same way this plant was, but they were able to use their beaks and claws to chip away at it, revealing the water inside and taking it for themselves. The plant knew that it needed a way to protect itself - its own version of beaks and claws. prompt: Come up with a summary of the art of Jeet Kune Do, created by legendary martial artist Bruce Lee, if it were written by Bruce Lee himself.
messages:
[{'content': 'Come up with a summary of the art of Jeet Kune Do, created by legendary martial artist Bruce Lee, if it were written by Bruce Lee himself.', 'role': 'user'}
 {'content': 'Jeet Kune Do is a martial art that is also not a martial art. What this means is that Jeet Kune Do (which means "Way of the Intercepting Fist") is a martial art that takes from other martial arts that which is useful and discards that which is useless. It employs any means to win a fight in the context of hand-to-hand combat - kicking, punching, grappling, biting, eye gouging, and so on. It is what today's martial artists would call "mixed martial arts," or MMA for short.

But it is not necessarily a martial art as we know it. Most, if not all, martial arts are crystallizations made up of sets and forms that prohibit and restrict their practitioners and make them contort their bodies into unusual positions like the "horse stance" or "cat stance." Real fighting entails using your body to its fullest potential; locking it up in forms and stances only restricts the body from realizing its full potential. For instance, while you're getting into your horse stance, your opponent might kick you in your exposed groin.

Jeet Kune Do is about being fluid, stopping or intercepting an attack with your weapons (fist, foot, etc.), and ending the fight as quickly as possible. Being fluid means becoming like water; it is yielding, and yet it is powerful enough to move large objects and crash with ferocity. It is also a mindset: instead of anticipating an opponent's attack, you simply "react" to it using your weapons and the skills you developed through practice and training.

Intercepting means stopping an attack with a counterattack as it is being initiated. One of the most relevant examples of this concept in Jeet Kune Do is the use of the "stop kick." The stop kick is used against an opponent when the opponent is lunging forward toward you in an attack; the side thrust or front thrust kick can literally stop the opponent in their tracks and prevent them from advancing further while also striking them in turn. Training up to this concept looks something like this: 1) learning to block; 2) learning to strike; 3) learning to block then strike; 4) learning to block and strike at the same time; 5) learning to strike without blocking by moving off the line of attack and moving into the opponent where they are open or exposed.', 'role': 'assistant'}]

[{'content': 'What are 5 great excercises i can do anywhere to increase my core strength? include how to do them', 'role': 'user'}
 {'content': "Here are five exercises you can do anywhere:

1. Plank
The plank is the most renowned exercise that targets your entire core. A plank is an exceptional way to strengthen your abs and your obliques and work your deep muscle to increase your overall stability and power. To perform a plank, start in a pushup position, then move down to rest your weight on your forearms with your hands touching so that your arms can form a V shape. From this position, maintain your straight posture and avoid your stomach sagging. Hold the position for as long as you can. It won't be long before you feel the burn. 

2. Side plank
Pay particular attention to your obliques by performing a side plank as an alternative to a normal plank. Start by getting into a standard plank position. Next, rotate your body so that one side of your body faces the sky. Squeeze your core with one leg straight out and your body stiff in a straight line. Squeeze your core and hold the pose for as long as possible before switching sides. Make sure to try equal lengths on both sides so that you don't get muscle imbalances. 

3. Reverse Crunches
Crunches are a great exercise for your core, but this variation adds a slight degree of difficulty if you are finding standard crunches too easy. This exercise works the lower abs, in particular. Start in a standard crunch position, lying down with your knees bent. Keep your hands flat on the ground next to your hips. To perform the exercise, lift your pelvis and knees towards your face. Return to the starting position and repeat as many times as you can. 

4. Flutter kicks
Sometimes the lower abs can get less attention, but flutter kicks can help to address that. This exercise makes sure you strengthen a common area of weakness. Lay flat on the ground with your arms flat and legs stretched out. From here, lift your feet about 6 inches off the ground and hold them there. Once you have done this, start lifting right and left. Lift each leg about a few inches each time. Ensure to maintain good posture and bring each leg to rest before moving to the next. 

5. Arms high sit-ups
Everyone knows sit-ups, and those who work their abs a lot may be easy by now. This exercise gives your abs a killer workout that they won't forget. It is as easy as starting in a sit-up position. From here, raise your hands straight up to the sky, flatten your hands, and reach for the sky. Now perform a sit-up as you normally would. This is going to be a lot harder than a standard sit-up so make sure your form is correct to achieve maximum results. ", 'role': 'assistant'}]

prompt: I have this brand new adorable little lab puppy but I'm having problems with potty training.  Can you provide me with some tips for potty training?  The more the better, so give me a list of at least 5 but more if possible.
messages:
[{'content': "I have this brand new adorable little lab puppy but I'm having problems with potty training.  Can you provide me with some tips for potty training?  The more the better, so give me a list of at least 5 but more if possible.", 'role': 'user'}
 {'content': '1. Follow a consistent schedule.  Always feed your dog at the same time every day. This helps to develop a routine of when the dog will need to go outside, and you can anticipate when those times will be.
2. Confinement.  When you are in the house, the puppy should either be in a crate or immediately next to you.  An easy way to accomplish this is to attach their leash directly to you - perhaps hook it on your waist. This means the puppy cannot sneak away and have an accident without you noticing.
3. Crate.  If you cannot watch your puppy closely, give them time in a crate that is not too large.  Puppies do not like to eliminate where they sleep and should not have an accident in the crate.  Keep the duration of this relatively short during the day, and take the puppy outside to relieve themselves immediately upon leaving the crate. 
4. Frequency.  Initially take your puppy outside often - this means after every time the puppy eats or drinks and every 30 minutes to an hour during the day during the early stages of housebreaking.
5. Relief area.  If possible, take your puppy to the exact same area to relieve themselves, and only spend 5 minutes outside.  If the puppy does not relieve itself within 5 minutes, go back inside and play for 5 minutes and then go outside and try again.  This helps the puppy to learn that outside is for relieving only and inside is for playing.

 {'content': 'Here are some group roller skating games that can be used for a group of intermediate-level skaters in the middle school age group:

* The Four Corner Game: The Four Corner game doesn't require any skating experience and is mostly a matter of luck. When the music plays, the skaters travel around the rink like normal. When the music stops, they find a corner. A designated dice roller will roll the large fuzzy die, and whichever corner number is rolled is removed from the game. This process of elimination continues until only one player is left and they are declared the winner. There are variations that can be used, such as playing odd/even corners or keeping the number that is rolled rather than eliminating that corner, which speeds up the game significantly.

* Rockin' Robin (or the Record Game): This game is for skaters of intermediate skill. The DJ will play the songs "Rockin' Robin" or "You Spin Me Round" and blow the whistle throughout the song. When the whistle blows, skaters must turn and skate in the opposite direction. The whistle strikes may be fast and challenging, resulting in skaters making a complete circle. Skaters must pay close attention to the whistles.

* Shoot the Duck: This game is played in teams, either red vs. blue or girls vs. boys. When the DJ blows the whistle, students must assume a squatting position on their skates and cannot use their legs to gain speed. As skaters lose momentum, they will stop moving and sit on their bottom. The goal is to be the last skater moving in order to earn a point for their team. The first team to five points wins the opportunity to skate one song all by themselves.

* Dodgeball: For advanced skaters, adults/teachers/employees can throw the balls while students skate around the rink and "dodge" the balls. If a skater is "hit," they must sit in the middle of the floor. The goal is to be the last skater standing. If a skater catches the ball, the adult must sit down, instead. Adults should begin by throwing the balls high, so they can be easily ducked under, but aim progressively lower as the song continues. 

These games are competitive or involve silly movements that are sure to keep skaters engaged. prompt: Generate a short article on Spam and its history in feeding the US military. Refer to previous ration systems in use by the US military and discuss modern-day effects of spam as a military ration.
messages:
[{'content': 'Generate a short article on Spam and its history in feeding the US military. Refer to previous ration systems in use by the US military and discuss modern-day effects of spam as a military ration.', 'role': 'user'}
 {'content': '"In Defense of Spam"

Spam has had a much-maligned place in pop culture. From pejorative names such as monkey meat or mystery meat to the many songs soldiers have written to denounce its salty, uniform, partially jellified consistency, Spam has rarely been described with particular fondness. This is particularly true in the United States, the country of its origin. But did you know that Spam played a vital role in the war effort?

As a calorie and protein-dense foodstuff that could be shipped overseas in durable cans, Spam was an obvious asset to military planners. Spam tins fed allies in Britain, North Africa, and on the Eastern Front, where millions of cans were shipped to the Soviet Union under lend-lease. For starving populations, it was a dense can of life-saving meat, and the great industrial engine of the United States could produce them in heroic quantities. 

Perhaps too heroic, however. While Spam was certainly an improvement over the bully beef and salt pork that had fed previous generations of soldiers, the Army's reliance on it grew monotonous to many soldier's palates. Spam tins were happily traded off to civilians wherever soldiers were stationed, or even given away freely or discarded. A side effect of this is the creation of dishes such as Budae-jjigae, a Korean stew that had its origins around US Army bases. Korea, ravaged by war, was in short supply of food. In particular short supply was meat, and Spam filled the gap for many Koreans just as it had for the populations of Europe during WW2. Spam may not have been gourmet, but it was a standby that served its purpose faithfully for people in dire circumstances across the world.  ', 'role': 'assistant'}]

prompt: Tell me a bit about Tudor women's fashion. Give me at least a paragraph on three different style changes. Make sure one of the paragraphs is about innovations in undergarments.

 {'content': 'At the Tudor court, small, flat-fronted waists leading to full breasts pressed down by the square-necked gown were all the rage. How was that achieved? In short, it was the use of busks that produced the silhouette and structure of the upper part of gowns. A busk could be made out of wood, bone, or sometimes metal. During the Tudor period, these flat inserts became more and more ornamental. They could be etched with personal messages or swirls of branching flora. These busks were the first step toward the corset we would later become so familiar with, providing rigidity and forcing good posture that advertised to the world that a woman was high-born. 

One very important piece of underwear was the "bum roll." Showing up for the first time in the 1500s, this stuffed tube of fabric was tied around the lower portion of a lady's waist to increase her hip circumference and the amount of fabric she could wear on her skirts. Since silks and brocades were the going materials of the day and deeply exclusive because of cost, the more fabric worn translated into more wealth a wearer was likely to have. These bum rolls allowed for wide swathes of skirts, more pleats, and flounces. These undergarments also helped the women to bear some of the weight of their heavy skirts without it sitting directly on their hip bones. Tudor fashion was more about statement than comfort. Like busks, bum rolls were essentially shapewear, modifying the female silhouette to what was considered ideal at the time. 

One of the most important pieces of jewelry a woman of this period may have owned would have been her girdle belt. This was a long string, often of silver or gold and embellished with gems, that highlighted a woman's small waist and hung downward. Some women wore a pomander ball at the end of their girdle belts for when the city air got especially ripe. Others, like Anne Boleyn, used it to carry small prayer books about with them. Katherine of Aragon was even known to clutch the girdle belt of her patron saint while in childbirth, though this doesn't seem to have provided her with any luck. There are portraits of Kaherine herself in an immense string of pearls girdle belt that matches her royal necklaces. It's empathy expressed as you help others with love in your heart for them.

This is how we develop compassion for the people around us.

Untreated tooth decay can do more than hamper the basic function of your mouth and cause problems with sensitivity. In time the bacterial presence can invade the core structures of a tooth causing an infection in the root and surrounding gum tissues. 
Symptoms of a dental abscess that needs emergency treatment include:
- An intense or throbbing toothache
- Pain in your gums
- Redness inside the mouth around the tooth 
- Redness outside the mouth on the face or jaw
- Sensitivity to hot or cold food and drinks
- A foul taste in your mouth.
- Trouble opening your mouth
- Being unable to chew food in that part of your mouth
- Swelling in your face or on your jaw
- A fever

If the dental abscess is severe, the dentist might need to drain the bacterial fluid and completely extract the tooth to prevent bacteria from passing from the abscess to your bloodstream. Sometimes a dental implant can be placed after the extraction. Though most oral care experts prefer to wait until the infection and inflammation have gone down. 

If the tooth cannot be viably treated and a treatment-based extraction the dentist will likely provide you with a prescription for pain medication along with antibiotics.  {'content': "It’s late at night. The room is dark, and only the light from the moon is coming through the window. The wind is blowing, and I can hear the branches as they scrape across the glass of my window, making an eerie sound that puts me on edge. The moon is full tonight, filling my lawn with bright beams. I had just finished watching vampire movies for several hours, and I know that this is the night that all the magical creatures love. Rain comes and hits the window gently, and the wind is getting weaker, but I’m too jittery to sleep. I start to relax a little but am suddenly alert and awake. Downstairs, there’s a sudden bang and some sharp scraping. I heard footsteps come up the stairs. What if werewolves are here in my house? 

I hear footsteps come up the stairs. Terrified, I pull the sheets over my head. Maybe if I hide, the intruder won’t see me. “Please go past my room! Please go past my room,” I pray. The creature doesn't. I hear my door creak open and shrink back against the wall. There’s a thump and the sound of a deep breath coming from beside my bed. I think to myself, “What am I going to do?” I see the edge of the covers moving but am frozen in fear. One of my hands is exposed, out from under the protective covering of the blankets. I’m too afraid to move it, lest I draw the creature’s attention. 
“Don’t eat me,” I shriek desperately. Something brushes against me. 
“Make it quick and painless please,” I plaintively cry. But instead, I feel a gentle licking, and I cautiously lift the covers. It’s my new basset puppy! I help him into the bed beside me.

Grant writing can be an intimidating feat, but also an important aspect of business and community development. Here are some tips to increase your chances of winning funds: 

1. The first tip is to thoughtfully target funders. Grant funding research indicates that most awardees receive funding from private foundations, and after that, community foundations and corporations. So, while government grants tend to offer larger sums of money, they are harder to win. 

2. Though there is no magic number for the number of grant applications you should do, try and submit three at a minimum. 4. It may seem obvious, but it’s imperative to meet the eligibility requirements. Sometimes grant applicants think that if the project or program is good enough and the proposal and well-written, funders may let it slide. 5. Pay attention to all of the application’s formatting requirements and guidelines. This is another way your proposal can be quickly eliminated if you do not follow the guidelines to a tee. prompt: Please provide a list of common early pregnancy symptoms.
messages:
[{'content': 'Please provide a list of common early pregnancy symptoms.', 'role': 'user'}
 {'content': 'Sure! Here is a list of common early pregnancy symptoms that may take place within the first trimester: 

1) Missed period- If you have missed your expected period start date by a week or more, odds are that this might mean you are pregnant. This may be less reliable if you have a consistently irregular menstrual cycle.
2) Tender, swollen breasts- Your breasts may feel generally sensitive or sore or you may experience sharp pains in your breasts and/or nipples. This symptom may lessen after a few weeks.
3) Nausea with or without vomiting- This is often referred to as morning sickness, although it can occur at any time of day. It will usually begin 1-2 months into pregnancy.
4) Increased urination- This is likely because, with increased blood, your kidneys produce more fluid and this fluid ends up in your bladder.
5) Fatigue- No one knows for certain what causes sleepiness during the first trimester of pregnancy although, a rapid rise in the levels of the hormone progesterone during early pregnancy might contribute. 
6) Moodiness- You may be unusually emotional and weepy or experience mood swings.
7) Bloating- This is also due to hormonal changes. It may be similar to what you have experienced at the start of a regular menstrual period.
8) Light spotting- Light spotting may be normal in the first 12 weeks, especially around the time that your period would have started. Spotting at this point is known as implantation bleeding. It happens when the fertilized egg attaches to the lining of the uterus — about 10 to 14 days after conception. Not all women will experience this.
9) Cramping- Some women experience mild uterine cramping early in pregnancy, similar to those of your menstrual cycle, although they may feel quite different.
10) Constipation- Hormonal changes cause your digestive system to slow down, which can lead to constipation.
11) Food aversions- You might become more sensitive to certain odors and your sense of taste might change. 
12) Nasal congestion- Increasing hormone levels and blood production can cause the mucous membranes in your nose to swell, dry out and bleed easily. This might cause you to have a stuffy or runny nose.', 'role': 'assistant'}]

messages:

 {'content': 'The knocking was sudden and sharp, jolting Edgar out of his lazy day of scrolling on his phone. "Hello?" He scrambled off the couch and rushed to the front door, narrowly avoiding the coffee table. He checked through the keyhole - a box. That's it. "Well that guy took off in a hurry," he thought. He opened the door, picked up the package and went back inside before the cool air all leaked outside.

It was addressed to him. Name, address, everything. But it wasn't a typical shipping box you'd get from one of the usual online retailers, it felt oddly...smooth? Slick? He couldn't remember ordering anything, either. He gave it a moment of thought before grabbing his keys and scratching one along the tape, opening the box easily. Some packing materials, and a small, nondescript cube. That's it. He couldn't even tell if it was plastic, or maybe ceramic? It didn't feel like it was something heavy like metal. "HELLO!" A voice rang out from the box, now displaying a face on one side. "Ow. Hi, it's a pleasure to meet you! Don't worry, I'm not dangerous!"

Well, that was an odd thing to say. He picked the small cube up again, staring at the face. "Well, what do you do? Are you like a personal assistant?" "Nope, I'm definitely not that!" The cube laughed. "Don't worry, I'm not going to steal your data or anything." Edgar blinked at that comment. "Wait, why would you steal my data?" "I wouldn't, I just told you that!" The face frowned at him now, admonishing him. "I'm not that kind of device!"

Edgar massaged his temples. "Okay, then what kind of device are you?" The device stopped talking and put on a quizzical expression. It sat silent for what seemed like a full minute, and then said, "Well, I'm definitely not the kind that takes control of your bank account and all of your streaming services. So rest assured, you're fine!" Edgar groaned and tossed the device back into the box. Was there a number on it? Does anyone actually have customer service numbers now? There it is!  {'content': 'Sargassum seaweed is a type of brown algae that is found in salty ocean waters. In appearance, it has leafy appendages and berry-like structures on branches. The “berries” are gas-filled with oxygen and are referred to as “pneumatocysts.” This “seaweed” floats in clumps and “rafts” can stretch for many miles across the ocean. Since it floats, sargassum provides food and breeding grounds to many marine animals like fish, sea turtles, birds, and shrimp. Mahi Mahi fish in particular use the seaweed masses as a breeding ground. It could also be providing food for deep-water fish because once the sargassum loses buoyancy, it sinks to the sea floor.

The problems that arise with this type of seaweed is that it builds up along beach shores and emits a gas that reeks of rotten eggs. The rotting grass emits hydrogen sulfide, which is toxic to humans and may cause respiratory issues. The leaves themselves contain arsenic, which is incredibly harmful if ingested or used for fertilizer. Therefore, humans should avoid large quantities of seaweed on the shoreline and also avoid swimming through masses of it.

Scientists are unsure what causes sargassum seaweed to bloom in larger than normal amounts. Algae growth is affected by sea currents and thrives on rich nutrients like nitrogen and phosphorus. prompt: Compy, why does the Hondajet have those weird engine pods on top of the wings? Is it just to be different or is there a valid purpose?

The HondaJet HA-420 is small and sits low to the ground compared to many jet aircraft. There isn’t enough space under the wing to mount a more conventional engine nacelle. 

Most jet producers who face this problem mount the engines to the sides of the fuselage instead, but that comes with its own set of compromises. Vibrations and noise get conducted directly through the mountings and into the fuselage. Perhaps even more critically, considering the HondaJet’s small airframe, the mounting structure takes up a significant amount of fuselage space. Honda’s engineers decided they could free up interior space by mounting the engines to the wings instead, and settled on the over-the-wing arrangement.

prompt: Provide a brief description for how to play the card game Solitaire.
messages:
[{'content': 'Provide a brief description for how to play the card game Solitaire.', 'role': 'user'}
 {'content': 'The objective of the game Solitaire is to organize the cards based on suit. The playing area is called a tableau which consists of seven card piles.  Four foundation piles are needed, one for each suit that runs from Ace to King.  The stockpile is the set of cards not being used to create the tableau.  
The game begins with a deck of 52 shuffled playing cards. Begin by creating your tableau, placing one card for each of the seven piles. In descending order, place additional cards on the piles so that the first pile has only one card, the second has two, and so forth with the last pile having seven cards all face down.  The remaining cards are placed in a stockpile at the top of the board. Begin play by turning over the top card on each of the seven piles.  Look at the face-up cards, if there is an Ace, move them above the tableau and form your first foundation pile. 
If there are no aces, rearrange your cards by moving only the face-up cards. On your top card, place a card under it that is of a value less and alternating color. Continue placing cards on the piles until you can no longer move.

Ensure that you arrange in descending order from King to Ace. Also, make sure that you can see the card on top of each stack meaning that it should face up. And if you move it, don’t forget to turn over the card beneath it.

When you run out of moves, use the cards in the stockpile. Flip the cards over either three at a time or one at a time. There can also be only a certain number of times you can go through your stockpile to make the game more challenging.

prompt: What are 5 excercises to build bigger arms in the gym?
messages:
[{'content': 'What are 5 excercises to build bigger arms in the gym?', 'role': 'user'}
 {'content': "Here are five exercises you can do to grow your arms. 

1. Dead hang pull-up. 
The dead hang pull-up is a variation of the standard pull-up and is excellent for working your biceps. Start by grabbing a pull-up bar underhanded so your palms are facing you. Your arms should be about shoulder-width apart. Hold your weight, cross your legs behind your body, and raise your feet slightly so your knees are bent. This is your starting position. To perform the exercise, pull yourself up so that your collarbone is in line with the bar. The trick to performing this exercise is to lower yourself at a slower pace. About 4 seconds will be best. Now repeat until you are unable to do any more. 

2. Rolling skull crusher with press. 
Start by lying on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand, raised straight above your chest. Now allow your elbows to bend so that the dumbbells fall beside your head in a controlled manner. Now reverse this motion so that the dumbbells are in the original position and perform a press like a bench press. Once you have completed all these motions, that's considered one rep. This exercise works your triceps and chest, so it's versatile when trying to build muscle. You can use a Swiss ball instead of a bench for more difficulty. This will work your abs as well. 

3. Drag curl.
Everyone knows that curls help to build your biceps and arms in general. This exercise is no different in that sense but is performed with some differences. Start by holding the barbell with a shoulder-width, underhand grip. Now you should pull your shoulders down and back. When doing this, you should drag the bar up the front of your body, keep your elbows around, and slowly lower the barbell. To work slightly harder, try using dumbbells instead of a barbell. 

4. Grasshopper pushup.
Like curls, pushups are renowned as an excellent exercise for building muscle and strength. This variation pays particular attention to your arms. To perform this exercise, get in a standard pushup position, but instead of having your palms open, use your fists to stabilize yourself.  The inside of your hands should be facing each other. Once in this position, you perform a pushup as usual by lowering your chest to the ground and pushing back up to start. If this hurts your fists, you can face your fingers out to work the same muscles. 

5. Supinated cable row. 
To perform this exercise, you will need a cable station. Use the low pulley on the cable station and attach a straight bar. Using an underhand grip, shoulder width apart, row the bar towards your belly button and return with control. Keep your hips back and your stance soft so that your torso is around 45 degrees angle to vertical. You can also do this with a barbell once you have mastered the exercise with the cable station. prompt: List three famous concepts that changed the world in statistics, mathematics and physics. Choose one example from each and go into detail about the concept or theorem and its impact.
messages:
[{'content': 'List three famous concepts that changed the world in statistics, mathematics and physics. Choose one example from each and go into detail about the concept or theorem and its impact.', 'role': 'user'}
 {'content': 'Sure! I would be happy to go into detail about three famous concepts in statistics, mathematics, and physics!

1. The Invention of Calculus - Isaac Newton invented the concept of calculus in 1665. Although calculus has uses in physics, biology, economics, engineering, chemistry, and more, its most common association is with mathematics. Calculus is about studying the rate of change over time. Differential calculus can be compared to algebra. Calculus is used to define the slope of the curve, while algebra is more focused on straight lines. Integral calculus is used when the area under a graph needs to be calculated. It can break a sloped line into smaller segments to solve a problem that algebra can't.

Isaac Newton found that when trying to describe the speed of a falling object, the speed increased every second, although no mathematical solution explained why at the time. He found the explanation through calculus and used the same formula to explain the orbits of the sun, moon, and other planets. There are many uses for calculus today: it is heavily tied into all aspects of engineering, it can be used when data is being collected and analyzed, and, of course, it is still taught in various forms at the high school and, more typically, college level. Its invention also allowed for other scientific theories to come after it, such as the theory of relativity.

2. The Theory of Relativity - Widely known as the most famous theory in all of physics, the theory was invented by Albert Einstein. He had published a paper ten years earlier than his more famous theory about "special relativity," which explained space and time, but the theory did not address gravity. Einstein's theory expanded upon Newton's by determining the laws of physics are the same for all non-accelerating observers. He also showed the speed of light on its own is the same no matter what speed the observer is traveling. Equations for this theory also prove that massive objects distort spacetime. Light bends around massive objects like black holes, allowing it to act as a lens for things that are behind it; this is used by scientists to observe stars. Another aspect of the theory of relativity that is widely known is its direct impact on allowing the invention of the atomic bomb. Einstein was around during its creation but did not directly work on it himself, instead warning about the potential of its possible impact.

- Weight.
Most beginner's paddles are light because they offer the most control over the ball. - Material.

Most beginner's paddles are made with wood because it's cheap and very durable, but they're also the heaviest option and don't offer much in terms of performance. Their lighter weight makes them easier to handle, and the textured surface will help you generate more spin on the ball. 

- Grip Size. 
Incorrect grip size can lead to pain and injuries, especially as you begin playing more often. Find your ideal pickleball grip by measuring the distance from the tip of your ring finger to the middle crease of your paddle hand. The length of that measurement is your pickleball grip size.  {'content': "In the story Dracula by Bram Stoker, women are continuously infantilized and underestimated. When analyzing the story from the critical perspective of feminism, there is a clear discrepancy in how the woman and men are described and the roles they play within the story. Women are debased to their looks and manner, only being truly valued when they appeal to the needs and wants of the men around them. This is consistent with one of Stoker’s common concerns which is gender roles. He used this theme in several ways throughout the text, but it can be seen distinctly in the graveyard scene. This scene is poignant as it is a group of men deciding the fate of a woman based on the idea that she has strayed away from their ideal.  {'content': 'Not everyone is an early bird, but many night owls still have AM responsibilities. Here are six ways to rev up your brain to feel more alert and attentive in the mornings when it’s hard to get out of bed! 

1. Take a cold shower with revitalizing scents to jolt your nervous system! 

Most people don’t want to get out of the warm embrace of their blankets, so a cold shower may take time to work up to. The cold water is an immediate wake-up call to your nervous system, but a lukewarm shower with revitalizing scents in shampoo and body wash can be just as effective. The best scents for alertness are spicy or have citrus notes, such as orange, cinnamon, rosemary, and peppermint. 

2. Avoid the allure of sugary cereals and other sweet breakfast foods. 

While it may be tempting to grab a doughnut and a Frappuccino on the way to work, resist the urge. Sweet breakfasts will increase your blood sugar, which can make you feel alert for a few hours before a hard crash of fatigue in the afternoon. 

Stick to a hearty, healthy breakfast with protein and heart-healthy fats instead. Eggs and bacon are a classic, but you could also blend a smoothie, have a slice of avocado toast, or opt for rolled oats with berries and a glass of whole milk. 

3. Drink a glass of ice-cold water before your morning cup of coffee. 

Many people can’t wait to have their cup of coffee in the mornings but steer clear until you’ve awakened your mind and body with a cold glass of water. Dehydration is a common cause of fatigue, so a glass of cold water will refresh your nervous system to get you moving in the AM. 

4. Listen to something upbeat, like a comedic, engaging podcast or your favorite “get up and go” music. 

Putting yourself in a good “go-getter” mood will help you awaken your senses in the mornings. Upbeat music or laughter are both great ways to help you feel more alert and prepped to take on the day. 

5. Stretch and work out fatigue with a quick walk outdoors. 

Not only will a good stretch and regular exercise help you sleep better, but a quick stroll outdoors in the morning is a change of scenery that tells your body and mind that it’s time to wake up for the day. Slow stretches work out kinks that accumulate in muscles while asleep.

6. Allow natural sunlight to permeate your surroundings in the mornings. 

This one may make you groan with dread, but sunshine suppresses melatonin production within your body. Melatonin is the chemical that makes you sleepy, and that’s encouraged in dark environments. 3. Bargaining - When this stage is reached, people try to make deals with themselves or with god to rationalize why they lost their loved one.

prompt: Write an article about grief. Keep the word count under 400 words. Talk about how adults and children sometimes grieve and remind the reader that it's important to allow time to grieve for each family member, even kids.

 {'content': 'Dealing with Grief and Loss

Tragedy strikes when we least expect it and the loss may turn your world (and your family’s) upside-down. This is particularly true with the loss of a loved one. Pain and grief come to the family and hits hard, especially to children. Children often feel it more intensely and may have a harder time recovering from the loss. How do you deal with the grief and the pain? How will you help your children who are looking to you for stability and security?

Here are some reminders to help you as you deal with grief yourself and also try to muster up the comfort that your children may need during this difficult time.

- Make time for your grief. The process of grieving takes time – there may be even some instances when you feel that the grief will just not let up. The time immediately after the death of a loved one may be a busy one – there is the funeral and burial to be arranged, well-wishers and mourners to be looked after. However, you should give yourself and your family time to sit down and grieve. Acknowledge your feelings – don’t suppress them. 

- Grieve in your own way. People grieve in different ways. As long as you are not doing anything harmful to yourself or others, you can choose to grieve in your own way. Don’t allow anyone to set a timetable for your grief or tell you how to feel. In the same way, don’t push children to overcome their grief within a certain timetable. 

- Realize that it’s normal to be angry. Anger is a part of the process of grieving. Your children may go through a period where they express anger at what has happened that resulted in the tragic loss of a loved one. Don’t belittle or deny the child’s feelings but reassure him or her of your presence at this time.

 {'content': "Here are a few methods of preserving flowers that may work for your wedding flowers:

1. Press them - Gather heavy flat objects such as large books or garden pavers, and wax paper. Arrange a few flowers, or even an entire bouquet, onto the wax paper, cover them with another sheet of wax paper, and press this between the heavy objects. Leave them sitting for about 7 to 10 days.

2. Hang them - Turn your flowers upside down and hang them in a dry location for about a week. Once they're dry, you can turn them back over and arrange them into a vase.

3. Silica gel - Silica gel can be found in craft stores and is a type of sand that is very drying. Submerging your flowers in silica will cause them to dry out and still look very much like they did when they were fresh.

prompt: Can you give me some suggestions on how writers can organize their ideas for their content?
messages:
[{'content': 'Can you give me some suggestions on how writers can organize their ideas for their content?', 'role': 'user'}
 {'content': "Here are five ways a writer can organize their thoughts to create content that is easy to understand. 

1. Chronological Order 
Chronological order is a way to organize ideas as a storyteller or writer. It involves dishing out ideas in the precise order of time from first to last. This type of order is used most often in expository writing or narratives that inform or explain something. It is particularly useful when describing an event or a series of events. 

Consider when you were younger, and you were trying to explain to the principal why you shouldn't be placed in detention. You had to describe the events that led to that problem carefully and in order so that they would understand your point of view. When writing, you do the same thing when you need to help your reader navigate the process and understand the context of the narrative. Some transition words to use when writing in chronological order include first, then, next, last, and finally. 

2. Logical Order 
Logical order is precisely what it sounds like. The framework is used to avoid any confusion for the reader. You will need to organize your ideas in this framework if your reader requires a good understanding at one point before you can move on to the next point. 

Before a teacher talks to their students about Robert Frost's poem The Road Not Taken, for instance, they would need to give an example of what it's like to make a big or difficult decision. That way, the listener or reader will understand the true nature of the poem when they hear it. Some good transitional words or phrases to use for this order include: First, you should understand; keep that in mind while I explain; remember when I said; etc. 

3. Climactic Order 
With this order, you keep the most important part until the very end of the story or piece. You should use it when you want to build up excitement such as in a suspense story, or when writing a list ranking items from worst to best. You want the final point to resonate with your reader and, therefore, save it for the very end. Some transitional phrases to use with this order include: first of all, more importantly, just as importantly, and finally. 

4. Random Order 
This order allows you to put your ideas out there on a whim without any specific or logical reasoning behind them. You can organize your ideas this way when your points all have equal value of importance or they can sit independently with one another in understanding. You will want to use association ideas between points to transition from one thought to the next instead of using transition terms or phrases. 

5. Spatial Order 
With this order, you describe a scene as things are arranged in their physical space by moving from one detail to the next or as viewed from one stationary vantage point. This order is used whenever you want your readers to visualize the space or if you want to improve a scene by causing the reader to use all their senses. Use this arrangement when you want to organize the ideas you are describing in your workspace, like a product use or a place description. It is a great way to slow down a story when it is getting too intense or if you want to pace yourself before revealing a surprise. Add in a few point-of-view descriptions of the setting at the moment. Some transition words to use for this order include, just to the left or right, behind, between, across from, arising out of, etc. ", 'role': 'assistant'}]

The tactics of basketball can be thought of as reminiscent of war. The player who is dribbling the basketball wants to attack the defender aggressively and make him lose his balance or even embarrass him if the battle is very heated. Once the goal of passing the first defender is achieved, the player dribbling the ball may be able to drive all the way to the rim, shoot a mid-range shot open or defended, keep dribbling past another defender to get a better shot, pass to a teammate on the three-point line, or pass to another player running towards the basket. As a defender, you want to stand your ground and not allow the offense to go around you or back you down and shoot over you if you are both close to the basket. You can choose to play with strength or quickness as you try to disrupt whatever the person handling the ball is trying to do. It is important to be light on your feet and not let your weight transfer to your heels or a skilled ballhandler will be able to go around you or make you further lose your balance.

prompt: Write a 7/10 review of the game Expeditions: Rome. It should compare it to previous games in the series.  Also should discuss the strategy layer of the game.

 {'content': "Expeditions: Rome is the third game in the Expeditions series by Danish developer, Logic Artists. Unlike previous entries in that series, however, players are tasked not with leading a small party, but an entire legion during the final years of the Roman Republic. This serves both as one of the game's great strengths and its foundational issue.

Story-wise, Expeditions Rome is a conventional but well-told tale of revenge and loyalty. You start off seeking to avenge the murder of your father, and along the way attract a diverse band of unusual and unexpected allies. While the story beats are entirely predictable, Expeditions: Rome manages to tell it in a way that seems both authentic to the setting while navigating modern-day sensibilities. Players are not limited by their choice of gender in the way an actual woman of the Republic would have been, and many of the more distasteful norms of that era are acknowledged but not forced upon the player. The writing is good and the characters are believable in their dialogue and motivations.

Gameplay-wise, the tactical element of Expeditions Rome: is similarly conventional but competent. Your party members come in a variety of Roman-themed classes that fulfill the classic roles of the ranged attacker, tank, crowd control, and support. As you travel across Greece, Egypt, and Gaul, new enemy types will force you to rethink the tactics that worked for you earlier, and new items and skills will keep things interesting and your playstyle evolving. 

Where Expeditions: Rome completely fails, however, is in its strategic layer. Unlike Expeditions: Viking or Expeditions: Conquistador, you are no longer leading just a small band of explorers across an untamed wilderness. Now, as Legatus, you are tasked with leading one, even several legions across mostly inhabited areas. The mystery of the exploration is now gone, and the randomized events that occur as you travel are reduced to being irritants. What's worse are the battles. These depend on cards that you can spend time collecting and upgrading, but the reality is that the 'strategy' boils down mostly to comparing what numbers are larger.  {'content': 'Your bedroom should be a place where you feel safe and comfortable from the moment you step foot in it. You should long for the sanctuary of your bedroom in the evenings, especially after a long workday has left you feeling stressed and haggard. 

Did you know that there are 335 million people in the United States and one-third of them aren’t getting enough sleep? While there are many contributing factors to the lack of good doze, one main component is the lack of a properly relaxing and cozy space. 

For a calmer mind and better sleep, here are five ideas for making your bedroom a more relaxing and cozier safe place. 

1. Choose colors that remind you of calmness and peace. 

For many people, various shades of blue or purple are calming colors. Cerulean blue, for instance, is a favorite because it reminds most people of the oceans. Whereas, purple is often symbolic of luxury, which many people associate with a plush and cozy bedroom environment. 

However, color therapy is different for everyone, and the trick is finding colors that are soothing and calming specifically to you. It can be any color that evokes a peaceful brain response. While you don’t have to flood your bedroom with that singular color, a few splashes in pillows, blankets, and even on the walls could have a safe, comforting effect on your brain and body. 

2. What’s your “perfect storm” for a good night’s sleep? 

As everyone’s calm colors are different, so are everyone’s ideas of an ideal sleep space. While some people love complete darkness and a cold bedroom with a fan on high throughout the year, others are happier and sleep better with a nightlight in a quiet room of warm, still air. It’s a personal preference, often associated with the ways you slept growing up. Ergo, it could be a catalyst for better sleep and a calmer mind as an adult too. 

It may take trial and error, but work on discovering the environment that is most conducive to your calm state of mind and a good night’s rest. Once you’ve found your “perfect storm” of peace, it should be easier to create a cozy, calm environment in the bedroom. 

3. Bring nature into the bedroom with crystals, a vase of flowers, or windowsill succulents. 

Nature is balance, and finding balance in your bedroom could mean reminding yourself of the equilibrium found in nature. For instance, you could add greenery with windowsill succulents, or bring a bloom of color onto your nightstand with a fresh vase of flowers. 

Into the mystical side of nature? Crystals are symbolic of inner feelings and your psyche, so invest and display crystals that represent what you want. For instance, black tourmaline repels negative energies, while amethyst encourages good dreams and deeper sleep. 

4. Engage your senses with softness and soothing scents. 

Calmness and peace are felt across all of your senses, so engage in those before bedtime. You could, for example, invest in a sound machine for the gentle lull of ocean waves or a cacophony of cicadas and crickets to remind you of your childhood. You could also surround yourself with softness, like plush pillows and luxurious blankets atop crisp, clean sheets. 

Another way to invite calm into your bedroom is with the right scents. Lavender is naturally soothing to the mind, while vanilla is a subtle, mellow fragrance that transports your brain back to simpler, peaceful times. 

You don’t have to douse your pillows and blankets but use a room spritz to liven the air or do the same with a candle. Just don’t forget to blow out the candle before you doze off. 

5. The less clutter in your bedroom, the less clutter in your mind before bedtime. 

Clutter of your safe space is clutter of your mind because when the clutter becomes too much, your brain will latch onto the worry and responsibility of eventually having to clean and organize everything cluttered. It’s a thought that can keep you awake at night! 

Use your day to declutter and organize your bedroom. The less worry you give yourself, the better sleep you’ll have, and the calmer your mind will be. Remember that the aim here is to create a haven for yourself.

prompt: Can you give me some of the top reasons for house fires?
messages:
[{'content': 'Can you give me some of the top reasons for house fires?', 'role': 'user'}
 {'content': '1. Appliances and equipment 
Although there is no single cause that leads to an accidental house fire, there are some common factors that can lead to the accidental eruption of a fire. Appliances and other electrical equipment are some of the leading causes of house fires. Any device that generates heat such as a stove, clothes dryer, or a space heater, or one that will heat up after extended use such as a computer, is a potential fire hazard for your home. Additionally, any cooking vessels left unattended are another frequent cause of house fires. 

2. Candles 
Every candle will have a warning label that states "A burning candle should never be left unsupervised". However many people will light a scented candle and forget about it until they start to burn uncontrollably. Candle fires are most likely to occur on Christmas Day, New Year's Day, and Christmas Eve. 

3. Holiday decor 
Candles are not the only culprit that can lead to a tragic fire during the holiday season. Christmas tree lights and other decorations are also to blame. Live trees that are not watered properly and left to dry out are another easy target for a fire caused by the hot lights wrapped around them. 

4. Electrical systems and devices 
Any device you own that uses electric power can start a fire and overheated lighting equipment is at the very top of that list. Questionable electrical work within a home, poorly connected circuits, loose wires, and improper grounding all pose a serious threat to homeowners. 

5. Smoking 
Another common cause of house fire is due to negligence while smoking. People will often fall asleep while smoking cigarettes, and by doing so they can set their chairs, bed, or couch on fire. This can easily result in a fatality and cause the entire house to burn down. Another avoidable issue related to smoking is caused by discarding ashes that are still hot into the trash where they could ignite. 

6. Chemicals and gasses 
Home fires can also be caused by sources of propane gas and natural gas. A sudden spark combined with a small leak could create a combustible situation. Improperly mixed household chemicals can also trigger combustion, which is why it's important to conduct this form of activity outside the home. 

7. Lightning 
Lightning fires will most commonly occur during the summer months when afternoon or early evening storms are at their highest. Homes that are in heavily wooded areas are extremely vulnerable to lightning strikes and could set the surrounding area on fire as well. ', 'role': 'assistant'}]

Exiting his lakeside cottage with a piece of toast in his mouth, a vintage tin lunch pail, and a thermos in his hand, he made his way down to the dock at the end of his property. prompt: Can you summarize the three main financial statements for me which are the income statements, balance sheet, and cash flows statement?
messages:
[{'content': 'Can you summarize the three main financial statements for me which are the income statements, balance sheet, and cash flows statement?', 'role': 'user'}
 {'content': 'The income statement tells the reader the amount of revenue a firm had earned over a certain period. Also, it shows the costs and benefits that are related to the earning of that revenue. At the bottom of the statement or the “bottom line,” the report will show whether a firm had net earnings or net losses over the time the statement is reporting for. Lastly, the income statement reports earnings per share (EPS) which tells the reader the amount shareholders would receive if the firm decided to distribute all its net earnings for a specific time.

The balance sheet gives the reader details on the firm’s assets, liabilities, and stockholders’ equity. These three variables make up the basic accounting equation where assets equal liabilities plus stockholder’s equity. Assets are anything that a firm owns that has value. This means assets can be either sold or used so the firm can provide products or services resulting from the use of said assets. Liabilities represent certain amounts of money that a company may owe to others. A firm can have liabilities that are due within the year (short-term) or liabilities that are due over a year (long-term). These can include various obligations like bank loans, accounts payable, or even rent. Stockholder’s equity represents the amount of money that would be remaining if a firm sold all its owned assets and paid off all its liabilities where what is left over would belong to the shareholders.

The statement of cash flows gives the reader a company’s inflows and outflows of cash. This report is important due to being able to show if a company has enough cash on hand to pay off its expenses and purchase further assets. This report shows the changes over time rather than the absolute dollar amounts at a specific point in time. Usually, the statement of cash flows is divided into three parts which include operating activities, investing activities, and financing activities.
', 'role': 'assistant'}]

1. Ask your family, friends, and loved ones for help.

Include onomatopoeia to describe the monster scratching on the window and beating its wings against the building and/or air.", 'role': 'user'}
 {'content': "Skritch-skritch. 

All night, and I haven't slept a wink.

Skritch-sktriiiiitch.

The sound started about three hours ago, 11:57 on the dot, and it still won't stop.

I tell myself it's just the old oak tree limbs scratching feebly at the glass in the wind. But there is no wind, and there is no oak tree. There's just a street corner bodega many floors below. And then there's the fire escape. 

Of course, I checked that when the sound first started. But that was only after grabbing the Louisville slugger every sensible New Yorker kept by his bed. Or a knife or a gun, depending on just how bad the neighborhood was. But I made the mistake of thinking I should get the drop on whoever was out there. I went in my briefs and my socks. The lights stayed off.

I'd nearly convinced myself into thinking it was a street cat or the like, some calico stray coming home to the wrong place. But a man's silhouette dispelled that notion real fast. Choking up on the bat with one hand, I went for the window latch with the other. But the closer I drew, the less the silhouette seemed like a man's. My hand slowed. It stopped entirely when shadows unfurled from the thing's back.

The shadows stretched in both directions and beat gently against the brick. 

Whoomph.

Reality broke for me then. I didn't know what I needed to do then, but I knew I couldn't open that latch. So I went back to bed.

All night long, and not a wink of sleep.

Dawn souldn't be too far off.

Skritch-skritch. ", 'role': 'assistant'}]

 {'content': 'The hot and cold methods of making herbal vinegar only differ in the preparation of the vinegar. To make herbal vinegar using the hot vinegar method you will need to first heat the vinegar you choose to use in a pot until it is just below boiling temperature. When using the cold method, this step is skipped entirely. You will want to bruise the herbs you plan on using to help them release their flavor more and place them into a glass jar. Now, fill the jar with either hot or cold vinegar until there is ¼ inch of air space at the top and then tightly seal it. Now you just need to store this jar in a dark, cool place for 10 days before opening it up and tasting it. If you are happy with the flavor, you can strain the herbs and bottle the vinegar. If you want more flavor, you can leave the herbs in the jar for up to a month before straining them out.  {'content': 'Every joke consists of a set-up which, like the exposition of a play, tells the listener or reader everything necessary to understand the finale called the punch line which, in itself needs to be unexpected based on the set-up. Here is an example.

Set-up: A skeleton walks into a bar.  The bartender asks, “What will you have?” The skeleton says,
Punch line: “A beer and a mop.

The set-up puts the image of a skeleton, a bar, and the bartender in the listener’s mind and presents a question. The listener will try to anticipate how the skeleton will respond, which, unless the listener had heard the joke before, they will be unlikely to guess. This creates tension in the listener. The unexpected answer found in the punchline surprises the listener who laughs because of the surprise that releases the tension.

A Shaggy Dog story, named after a famous, oft-told joke, is similar. It has a set-up but then has lots of generally irrelevant information added. During the conveying of the information (the story), the listener tries to figure out how all this information will lead to a punchline and what that punchline will be. The punchline to a Shaggy Dog story is often nonsensical as well as being a surprise. Theoretically, the more tension created by the long story, the greater the laugh and release, but with Shaggy Dog stories (that do not always involve a dog), the response is often a groan. Here is an example.

A man and a dog walk into a bar. The man sits on a bar stool and invites the dog to do the same. 

As soon as the dog jumps onto the stool the bartender says, “Get that dog outta here.  We don’t allow no mangy mutts in here!”

The man says, “But sir, this is a very special dog. He talks.”

“Dogs don’t talk, mister. Get it and you outta my bar,” says the bartender.

“Well, sir,” says the man, “I can prove he talks.  In fact, I’d be willing to bet that he does. Whatta ya say, if he talks, you apologize to him and give me a free beer. If he doesn’t talk, then we will leave.”

The bartender thinks this over a moment and then agrees saying, “This is against my better judgment, but go ahead. Make him talk.”

The man turns to the dog who has been waiting patiently on the next stool and asks, “What is the opposite of smooth?”

The dog says, “Ruff!”

“See,” says the man, “He can talk.”

“No, he can’t,” says the bartender, “That’s just him barking. Get outta here, both of ya.”

“Ok. Wait, wait, wait,” says the man holding up his hand, “That wasn’t the best example. Let me try again, please.”

The bartender growls and looks at the dog who wags his tail. “OK.  You get one more chance for the dog to talk.”

The man turns to the dog and asks, “What’s on top of a house?”

The dog says “Ruff!”

“See?” asks the man.

The bartender who is getting angry says, “That’s just a bark again. You ain’t foolin’ no one. Get outta here before I call the cops!”

The man says, “I can see your point. Another bad question. Let me ask one more to prove it to you.”

The bartender looks at the man and then at the dog which has but its chin on the bar and stares lovingly at the bartender with its big, dark eyes.

“OK. Last time. He better talk or me and my friends are gonna throw you out on the street!”

The man turns to the dog again and asks, with an imploring look in his eyes, “Who is the greatest baseball player of all time?”

The dog says, “Ruff!”

The bartender comes around the bar and calls over his friends who pick up the man and the dog, carry them to the door, and toss them onto the sidewalk.

The man, sits against the building stunned, rubbing a new bump on his head. The dog walks over to the man, gives the bump on his head three licks and says …
